mechanism: Alpha lipoic acid may reduce tobramycin nephrotoxicity through antioxidant mechanisms, potentially affecting drug exposure and efficacy, while tobramycin's ototoxicity risk may be modulated by concurrent antioxidant therapy.
action: Monitor renal function and tobramycin levels closely; alpha lipoic acid may be considered as adjunctive nephroprotection in high-risk patients, but efficacy requires clinical validation.
